title: South Street Sam breaks down the art of the perfect shot

people.name: Judayah Murray
people.role: interviewer, FOX 29 Philadelphia Live (captioned as 'Jada Murray')

mentions.speaker: Sam (Sami Aziz)
mentions.quote: uh portraits on South Street every single day for a year straight
mentions.locationEvidence: Street named explicitly by Sam, several times. No cross streets, block range or landmarks given anywhere in the video, so it cannot be narrowed below the corridor from this transcript. The only South Street address clue is South Street Souvlaki (a delivery pickup, not a shooting spot; see excluded).
mentions.notes: Supporting lines, all Sam: 303s 'I've taken over uh 100,000 portraits on South Street and 150,000 in general'; 289s 'um on South Street for sure' (Spider-Man kid moment, 'on the corner' at 235s, corner never named); 816s 'I'll be out there tonight' followed by 819s 'go shoot tonight' (answering the interviewer's question about catching him on South Street). Interviewer confirms at 135s 'space, but you still go back to South Street and also do street photography'. This is a studio/remote interview; no shooting happens in the video itself, so basis is haunt, not shot-here. The Visit Philadelphia video (Sitl10hzZxc) has the better quote (present-tense daily habit).

mentions.place: South Philadelphia Sports Complex (the stadiums area)
mentions.speaker: Sam (Sami Aziz)
mentions.quote: of Philly. I've I've gone down towards the stadiums
mentions.locationEvidence: 'the stadiums' in Philadelphia = the sports complex around Broad St and Pattison Ave (Lincoln Financial Field, Citizens Bank Park, the arena). 'down towards' is vague: could mean the complex itself or just that direction in South Philly.
mentions.notes: Borderline, flagged for the caller. Context is 82s 'since then I've expanded to other parts' (of Philly), right after describing his South Street portraits, so shooting there is implied but he never says 'shot' or 'portraits' about the stadiums, it is not shown in this video, and it is not stated as a regular habit. Strictly it meets neither 'shot in this video' nor 'regular haunt'; recommend not mapping it on this evidence alone.
